decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The proposed generator shall be used as an emergency generator only and shall not be in operation for any other purpose other than the testing of the equipment.

Condition : 3 - INFORMATIVE:

Cranes:
Given the nature of the proposed development it is possible that a crane may be required during installation. The Local Planning Authority would therefore draw the applicant's attention to the requirement within the British Standard Code of Practice for the Safe Use of Cranes, for crane operators to consult the aerodrome before erecting a crane in close proximity to an aerodrome.  This is explained further in the Advice Note 4, "Cranes and Other Construction Issues" (also available at www.caa.co.uk/srg/aerodrome).
